description: Main Branch role cards: print the selected agent role at session start. Silent in repos with no core/roles/ folder.

hooks.command: if command -v mb >/dev/null 2>&1 && out=$(mb role hook --source startup 2>/dev/null); then [ -z "$out" ] || printf '%s\n' "$out"; elif set -- "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"/core/roles/*.md && { [ -e "$1" ] || [ -L "$1" ]; }; then printf '%s\n' 'MAIN BRANCH ROLE CHECK FAILED: this repo has role cards (core/roles) but the role could not be loaded. STOP. Do not start work and do not pick a role yourself. Tell the owner this message and ask them to fix the role setup. This session has no role.'; fi; exit 0
